📍We have nothing new to say, and America cannot win Iran's trust unless it implements the seven conditions| Threats and military moves cannot sway the strategic decisions of the Islamic Republic🔖Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf, in a meeting with Asim Munir held on Tuesday evening in Baharestan, noting the brotherly ties between Iran and Pakistan, expressed his appreciation and gratitude for the solidarity of the Pakistani nation and government, who stood by Iran in times of war and negotiation. 📌Field Marshal Asim Munir, too, in this meeting, while conveying the greetings of Mr. Ayaz Sadiq, Speaker of the National Assembly, and Shahbaz Sharif, Prime Minister of Pakistan, stressed the continuation of cooperation between the two countries.📌Asim Munir, responding to the follow-up by the Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly on border exchanges between the two countries, said the border issues had been temporary and technical, and the border between the two countries has been open since today. 📌In this meeting, Dr. Qalibaf, referring to the negotiations that took place between Iran and the United States in Islamabad, said: There I told the Vice President of America plainly that the long record of America's hostile actions against Iran before and after our Islamic Revolution has left us at the peak of distrust toward America, and now, with the Trump administration's violation of the Islamabad understanding, his repeated threats have built this edifice of distrust even higher than before.📌We have nothing new to say, and America cannot win Iran's trust unless it implements the seven conditions set out by Iran, which were presented in New York. We are not warmongers, but we are fully prepared to defend📌 our homeland and our national dignity; threats and military moves cannot sway the strategic decisions of the Islamic Republic of Iran. 📍Message from the Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly on the occasion of the Iranian national freestyle wrestling team's championship at the World Under-23 Championships

📌The commanding championship of the national freestyle wrestling team of the Islamic Republic of Iran at the World Under-23 Championships in America, and the raising of Iran's proud flag atop this arena, once again made Iran's name resound across the world and once again showed that Iran's consecutive wrestling championships are no accident — they are the product of a path that has been built, deeply rooted, and honor-creating; a path that begins with will and faith, is refined through knowledge, practice, and perseverance, and culminates in the conquest of the peaks of honor through zeal and courage on the field of competition. The continuity of Iran's wrestling championships is the story of a nation that raises champions, and of young people who spare no effort for the pride of Iran's name.

📌You raised Iran's proud flag on American soil while they, in their foolish imagination, dreamed of erasing the name of your homeland from the map — and your zealous fight forced them to respect that name and that sacred flag. With knowledge and action you surpassed your opponents and conquered a stronghold with the weapon of sport, the fruit of which was the sacred anthem of the Islamic Republic of Iran resounding across their land. You created moments in which the world stood in respect before the greatness of Iran's name. This is not merely a sporting victory; it is a manifestation of the authority of a nation whose children, in every arena, with every tool, and in every field, can compel the world to show respect — just as all the soldiers of this land, through their steadfastness and sacrifice, have upheld Iran's dignity and pride and have made the world bow before a proud Iran.

📌I congratulate this great victory to you champions, to your proud families, and to the great nation of Iran, and I sincerely thank the unceasing efforts of you honor-creators, the coaches, the technical staff, the management of the Wrestling Federation, and all those involved who, through planning, knowledge, unceasing effort, and dedication, laid the groundwork for this honor.

Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf
Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly
